research_question: Can one identity-initialized Full-path residual-strength gate slightly improve adapted AttnRes while producing a native token signal that is useful for later dynamic ReSkip?

positioning.secondary: post-hoc ReSkip relevance as a free byproduct
positioning.not_required: ReSkip does not need to outperform Full AttnRes

candidate.name: S1_rsg_h1
candidate.initialization: all gate weights and biases are zero; g_b(t)=1 exactly
candidate.objective: task CE + 1.0 * Full teacher KL - 0.02 * native route entropy

control.name: F0_reused_attnres_h1
control.reason_for_reuse: same seed, data mix, 3000 steps, adapter rank, gamma schedule, Full-only objective, and H=1 native AttnRes recipe; fi_weight was exactly zero

primary_evidence: paired held-out task CE delta versus original AttnRes
paired held-out teacher KL delta versus original AttnRes
secondary_evidence: token/block distribution of learned gate factors
Spearman relation of gate factors and deviations to forced-skip KL and top-1 flip
comparison with w_recent and native correction ratio on the same tokens

interpretation.policy: continuous evidence, not a mechanical multi-gate pass/fail rule
interpretation.stop_if: clear Full-path degradation, operationalized as CE delta greater than 0.005 or teacher-KL delta greater than 0.01 without compensating benchmark evidence
interpretation.continue_if: Full is neutral or slightly improved and the gate has nontrivial token variation or useful skip-risk association
interpretation.retain_as_full_only_if: Full improves consistently even if skip relevance is weak

anti_stacking_rule: This arm is trained once from the pretrained base and does not continue from any prior candidate. No component may be added after observing this arm's screen result under the same experiment id.
